The issuer's own language is singular: 'the Telfer-Havieron gold-copper complex', 'a substantial and long-life gold-copper operation'. One tailings system, one FIFO camp, one power station, one road from Port Hedland, one Paterson Province approvals envelope. There is no second place to send the ore, so 100%. GGP weights at roughly 7% against the 10% cap, so this moves no weight today; it is recorded because the definition rather than the arithmetic decides it, and a future weight above 10% would make it binding.
